name: frontend-design-taste
description: Context-aware frontend design taste & motion choreography plugin (v2.1): analyzes your project's purpose and user scenarios first, routes to the right visual & motion archetype ([data-theme], [data-type], [data-motion]), and applies real-world patterns from 10 curated design sites with physics-generated CSS linear() springs, View Transitions, @starting-style recipes, and Tailwind tokens.
suggestedPrompts: 先分析这个项目的用途和用户使用场景，选出最适合的设计流派再帮我重构页面
用 anti-ai-audit 检查当前页面是否存在风格错配或 AI 模板味，并给出贴合业务的改造方案
基于项目定位为我挑选合适的配色主题、字族预设和微交互策略
